rows.remaining: This row proves the pinned DXC target progression and PSO linking for the synthetic corpus; it does not claim exhaustive opcode or stage coverage.

The SM5.0 vertex/geometry/pixel chain returns exactly 1,352 nonzero pixels and center pixel 0xff407e81. Broader geometry topology, resource, stream-output, adjacency, and multi-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The SM5.0 vertex/hull/domain/pixel chain with integer partitioning, triangle topology, three control points, and factor one returns exactly 1,352 nonzero pixels and center pixel 0xff407e81. Broader patch layouts, partitioning, topology, factors, resources, and state remain in the exhaustive row.

The exact semantic readback set covers arithmetic, hyperbolic/normal math, msad4, SM6.4 dot2add and signed/unsigned dot4add packed accumulation, pack/unpack 4x8 signed/unsigned truncation and clamp modes, SM6.9 vector-reduce-and/or, buffers, barriers, wave/quad operations, SM6.7 vector/int64 arithmetic, SM6.8 wide arithmetic, and SM6.9 float16 conversion.

The source-staged control-flow cases cover a multi-block switch, PHI merge, loop-carried aggregate state, vector aggregate extraction, and exact four-lane readback; nested-control and broader aggregate forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The parser now resolves LLVM vector element type references without self-recursion and the SM6.7/6.8 vector lanes remain exact; first-class LLVM array values and broader matrix/type lowering remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged atomic matrix exercises add, and, or, xor, signed/unsigned min/max, and exchange with exact old/new-value readback; 64-bit atomic resource-class breadth remains in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged vector lane proves a four-component shuffle and aggregate arithmetic across four dispatch lanes; broader vector comparisons, inserts, matrices, and aggregate memory forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged 2x2 matrix construction, row extraction, vector-matrix multiply, and aggregate arithmetic return exact [17,27,37,47]. Broader matrix dimensions, matrix memory layouts, conversions, and helper-function boundaries remain in the exhaustive row.

A source chain of three helper functions returns exact [42,66,98,138] after validated DXC entry-point optimization. Preserved DXIL library calls, exported helpers, recursion rejection, and broader parameter/result shapes remain in the exhaustive row.

The SM6.9 source-staged lane combines uint16_t, int16_t, and float16_t arithmetic and conversions with exact [65085,65096,65107,65118] readback. Broader native-16 resource, atomic, matrix, and graphics-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged lane proves the selected double arithmetic expression through exact integer readback. Runtime-input lanes preserve the exact IEEE-754 binary64 payload 0x400921fb54442d18 through DXIL makeDouble/splitDouble and integer/double bitcasts, execute software binary64 addition/subtraction, multiplication, division, ordered/unordered comparisons, float/integer conversions, FAbs, FMin/FMax, special-value predicates, and fused multiply-add, and match exact-bit matrices covering signs, cancellation, subnormals, overflow, infinities/NaN, and round-to-nearest-even boundaries. Generated MSL contains no unsupported native double spelling. Direct FRem lowering uses the software remainder helper; compiler-expanded HLSL fmod and broader binary64 operation combinations remain in the exhaustive row.
Unsupported semantics are rejected instead of being promoted through placeholder MSL; implementation breadth remains tracked by the open exhaustive row.

Single external-counter compute append/consume plus vertex/pixel append semantics are exact; a directly indexed AppendStructuredBuffer heap shader compiles to DXIL and rejects PSO creation with exact E_FAIL, proving that boundary fail-closed; multi-counter and other graphics stages remain fail-closed.

The focused runtime proves compute append values 100..103 with counter 4, consume values 200..203 with counter 0, vertex append values 10..12 with counter 3, and pixel append values 0..3 with counter 4. Multi-counter, dynamically indexed counter-heap, and other graphics-stage forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The corpus links one counter UAV and rejects a two-counter shader with E_FAIL; the focused SM6.6 matrix also compiles and rejects a directly indexed counter heap with E_FAIL; non-vertex/pixel graphics-stage counters remain fail-closed.

Memory and disk-session key/value semantics, size queries, replacement, limits, missing-key errors, executable stored-compute-pipeline recreation, state-object database factory routing, pipeline descriptor version callbacks, and deep-copied application identity callback state plus collection descriptor/parent-key/version callbacks with deep-copied fixed-size STATE_OBJECT_CONFIG, node-mask, and raytracing config payloads are covered. The persisted file round-trip reloads application, pipeline, and state descriptors in a fresh database instance, including RAYTRACING_PIPELINE_CONFIG1 flags, a deep-copied DXIL_LIBRARY bytecode/export payload, a deep-copied procedural HIT_GROUP string payload, and a deep-copied DXIL_SUBOBJECT_TO_EXPORTS_ASSOCIATION target/export-string payload; read-only stores reject with E_ACCESSDENIED and malformed files reject with ERROR_BAD_FORMAT. Other pointer-rich state subobjects remain explicitly E_NOTIMPL pending their variable-payload deep-clone and persistence support in the exhaustive row.

The focused matrix covers the current SM6.6/6.7 atomic, raw/structured descriptor indexing, texture, static and programmable offset, typed-texture, sample-compare, gather, QuadVote, root-constant provider, and SM6.8 SampleCmpGrad/SampleCmpBias cases; complete SM5.x–SM6.9 opcode/stage/resource coverage remains open.

The focused descriptor-indexing row now covers two-, four-, and eight-way ranges plus scalar, two-component, four-component nested, raw, structured, sampled, comparison, and writable paths.
The audit covers reports emitted by the focused invocation; it is not an exhaustive title corpus.

The source-staged matrix proves exact sample/load, GetDimensions, and readback for 1D, 1D-array, 2D, 2D-array, 3D, cube, cube-array, and 2D MSAA textures plus UAV stores for 1D/1D-array/2D/2D-array/3D. Height-one Metal 2D backing additionally proves nonzero 1D/1D-array mips; MSAA UAV stores and broader operation coverage remain tracked separately.

Mip-1 scalar/array 1D sampling and GetDimensions pass over height-one Metal 2D backing; a combined level/bias/gradient/static-offset lane returns 0x14323232; pixel-stage clamped/unclamped CalculateLevelOfDetail returns exact 0x3f800000 while mixed vertex/pixel regular/depth 2D/1D/1D-array comparison sampling sums to exact 0x40800000; all standard min/mag/mip and anisotropic filters return exact values; clamp/wrap/mirror/border/mirror-once and the three Metal-representable border colors return exact values; native depth sample_compare returns exact point/linear/static-offset, level, gradient, bias, 2D-array, cube, and cube-array results; color/depth gather and their static-offset forms return exact four-component neighborhoods; unrepresentable dynamic-border and min/max reduction samplers remain fail-closed with the exact 0xdeadbeef sentinel; and the resource matrix creates a five-mip 1D array without a Metal assertion. Broader comparison address modes and non-pixel graphics-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

Native depth 2D-array, cube, and cube-array SampleCmpLevelZero return exact float bits [0x3f800000,0x3f800000,0x3f800000], with exact sum 0x40400000; vertex/pixel logical Texture1D and Texture1DArray comparisons contribute to a separate exact 4.0 sum; and the complete comparison address matrix returns exact clamp [0,1], opaque-white border [1,1], wrap [1,0], mirror [0,1], and mirror-once [0,1] pairs. Geometry, hull, domain, amplification, and mesh-stage comparison combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged R32_UINT Texture2D<uint> Load/GetDimensions case proves metadata element type propagation into an integer Metal texture view; the expanded typed-family row covers signed, writable, normalized, packed 10/11-bit, scalar 64-bit, writable MSAA 2/4/8-sample texture breadth with exact resolve readback, and pixel-stage GetRenderTargetSamplePosition/GetRenderTargetSampleCount lowering with custom sample positions, while broader multisample typed combinations remain exhaustive work.

The focused source-staged matrix proves R32_SINT and R32_UINT read views plus an R32_UINT writable view with exact readback; R16/RG16/RGBA8, normalized/packed, and scalar 64-bit breadth is covered by the expanded row while MSAA-UAV forms remain exhaustive work.

The 42-case source-staged matrix proves R32/R16/RG16/RGBA8 signed, unsigned, floating, and normalized access; packed R10G10B10A2 UINT/UNORM and R11G11B10 FLOAT; and scalar signed/unsigned 64-bit R32G32_UINT reads/writes with exact logical or storage-bit readback. The focused writable-MSAA source probe additionally proves 2/4/8-sample and array stores, loads, resolves, programmable sample-position options, and a graphics-stage MSAA path with exact values; broader multisample typed combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

Positive and negative evidence is still incomplete for the full stable SM5.x-DXBC through SM6.9-DXIL opcode/intrinsic, graphics-stage, texture-dimension, multi-counter, cache, and compiler-session matrix.
